overall.name: Vienna Advent markets 2026 (more than 20 official markets per austria.info)
overall.opening: Earliest: Stephansplatz and Schoenbrunn from Fri 6 Nov 2026. Wiener Christkindlmarkt (Rathausplatz) from Fri 13 Nov 2026.
overall.closing: Most close 23 Dec; Rathausplatz, Stephansplatz, Maria-Theresien-Platz and Schwarzenbergplatz close 26 Dec; Belvedere 31 Dec; Schoenbrunn and Riesenradplatz winter market 6 Jan 2027.
overall.daily_hours: Varies by market, see markets. Rathausplatz 10:00-22:00 daily.

markets.closed_or_special: Thu 24 Dec: 10:00-18:30. 25 and 26 Dec open normal hours (no exception listed). Ice skating 'Eistraum am Christkindlmarkt': 13 Nov 2026 to 6 Jan 2027, daily 10:00-22:00, 24 Dec 10:00-18:30, CLOSED 31 Dec. 'Wiener Eistraum' (the big rink in front of the Rathaus, separate from the Christmas rink): Fri 22 Jan to Sun 7 Mar 2027, 10:00-22:00. So the Wiener Eistraum is NOT open at Christmas; the Eistraum at the Christkindlmarkt is. Trams 1, 71, D (Rathausplatz/Burgtheater), U2 Rathaus, U3 Volkstheater.
Thu 24 Dec: 10:00-16:00. Open 25, 26 and 31 Dec (10:00-19:00) and 1 Jan 10:00-19:00. Over 90 huts; Glice ice rink (free for children), curling lanes, carousel, Ferris wheel, children's train.
markets.status: official 2026 (wien.info day-by-day listing; organiser site not read)

markets.closed_or_special: 24 Dec and 31 Dec: 11:00-17:00. Max 35 huts, use limited to the area in front of the Upper Belvedere. CONFLICTS: austria.info says close 22:00 and 24-27 Dec 11:00-17:00; wien.info overview says Mon-Fri '11am-2pm'. We use the organiser's own site.

markets.closed_or_special: Closed from 24 Dec. Only Austrian Advent market with fully certified organic catering (per wien.info).

24 Dec: 11:00-16:00. 25 and 26 Dec: 11:00-19:00. About 40 huts at the foot of St Stephen's Cathedral.

markets.dates_2026: Winter Market, Riesenradplatz (Prater): Fri 20 Nov 2026 to Wed 6 Jan 2027. Christmas Village at University Campus (Alserstrasse): 13 Nov-23 Dec. Christmas Magic, Schwarzenbergplatz (new in 2026): 13 Nov-26 Dec.

silvesterpfad.dates_2026: Thu 31 Dec 2026, 14:00 to Fri 1 Jan 2027 02:00; food and drink stands from 11:00; free entry.
silvesterpfad.locations: Freyung, Am Hof, Graben, Stephansplatz, Kaerntner Strasse, Neuer Markt, plus Rathausplatz and Riesenradplatz in the Prater (eight locations per wien.info; 2025 list in the vienna.at report matches).
silvesterpfad.midnight: Pummerin bell of St Stephen's and the Blue Danube waltz at midnight. Neujahrskonzert (Vienna Philharmonic) broadcast live on screens at Stephansplatz and Riesenradplatz from 11:15 on 1 Jan 2027.
silvesterpfad.fireworks: Rockets and bangers (F2 and above) banned throughout Vienna (wien.info).
silvesterpfad.security_2026: NOT VERIFIED. 2025 rules in official crime file (prohibited items, bag checks, Stephansplatz U-Bahn closed from 21:00).
silvesterpfad.other: Eistraum at the Christkindlmarkt is closed on 31 Dec. Silvesterlauf (49th in 2025, Ringstrasse, 11:00): 2026 edition NOT VERIFIED.

sights.detail: Church open Mon-Sat 06:00-22:00, Sundays and public holidays 07:00-22:00. Sightseeing times: Mon-Sat 09:00-11:30 and 13:00-16:30; Sundays and public holidays 13:00-16:30. 'Subject to change for liturgical reasons.' Page undated (read 8 Oct 2026). Public catacomb tours Mon-Sat 10:00, 11:00, 11:30, 13:30, 14:30, 15:30, 16:30; Sundays and holidays 13:30-16:30. Self-guided visit EUR 8 adult, EUR 3 child (to 14); All-Inclusive ticket EUR 29.

sights.item: St Stephen's Cathedral: Christmas Eve, Christmas Day, 26 Dec visitor hours and Mass/Christmette times
sights.detail: NOT VERIFIED. The cathedral site says restrictions may apply for liturgical reasons and refers to its 'Termine' page, which we could not load. Assume sightseeing is closed during services and heavily restricted on 24-25 Dec.

Palace is 'open daily, including public holidays'. 3 Nov 2026 to 31 Mar 2027: 08:30-17:00 (last admission 45 minutes before closing). No separate 24/25/26 Dec exception is printed, so general hours apply; shorter hours on 24 Dec cannot be ruled out (NOT VERIFIED). Park gates open 06:30; Nov-Dec park closes 17:30. Fountains off mid-Oct to mid-April; palace and Gloriette festive lighting suspended for energy saving. Children's Museum 10:00-17:00. Tickets only from official shop (site warns of fake ticket sites).

Visitor centre (Michaelerplatz 1, under the Michaelerkuppel) Mon-Sun 09:00-16:00; souvenir shop 09:00-16:30. Children under 3 not admitted. Performance and Morgenarbeit dates for 24-26 Dec 2026: NOT VERIFIED (calendar not loaded).

Hofburgkapelle Mass with the Boys' Choir / Vienna Choir Girls at 09:15 on Sundays 6, 13, 20 and 27 Dec 2026, on Friday 25 Dec 2026 and Sunday 3 Jan 2027 (wien.info listing). Mass is a religious service; seating limited. Christmas concerts at Konzerthaus/MuTh and Christmette on 24 Dec: NOT VERIFIED.

From the operator's own calendar (read 8 Oct 2026): 7 Dec 10:00-22:15; 8 Dec 10:00-22:15; 23 Dec 10:00-22:15; Thu 24 Dec 10:00-16:45; Fri 25 Dec 10:00-22:15; Sat 26 Dec 10:00-22:15; 30 Dec 10:00-22:15; Thu 31 Dec 10:00-02:00; Fri 1 Jan 2027 10:00-22:15. Weather closures possible. Winter Market at Riesenradplatz: see markets.

2026 timetable NOT published yet. Pattern last year, latest year only (2025), from the official Wiener Linien page published 22 Dec 2025: on 24 Dec Saturday timetable until 18:00; then trams and buses at least every 15 minutes; U-Bahn runs through the night 24 to 25 Dec. On 31 Dec Saturday timetable by day (diversions around Ring/Kai in the morning because of the Silvesterlauf); U-Bahn as usual overnight and many tram/bus lines run all night with shorter intervals; Stephansplatz U-Bahn closed from 21:00. Expect the same pattern in 2026 but confirm in December.
